title: Elgato Key Light Session Brightness Leaderboard
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=elgato:keylight brightness_pct=*
| stats sum(brightness_pct) as total_value, avg(brightness_pct) as avg_value by room_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks room name values by total and average brightness across Elgato Key Light session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `brightness_pct` values for each Elgato Key Light session event and review total and average brightness by room name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total brightness.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which room name shows the biggest brightness numbers in your Elgato Key Light session data.
